newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Thierry Daman said the Commission would hold its weekly meeting on Wednesday in Strasbourg, starting at 0830/0730 GMT. He also said Commissioners Edith Cresson and Franz Fischler would hold a news conference on an action plan on research into Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (TSE) at 1230/1130 GMT. Daman said the news conference would be transmitted in Brussels.
He added that Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard would hold a news conference on genetically modified maize and evaluation of several environment plans and programmes at 1500/1400 GMT in Strasbourg.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1008: Court of Auditors' report 1995: Commission reacts to Court's observations.
- IP/96/1009: Court of Auditors' "statement of assurance" (or DAS) 1995 - The Commission's response.
- IP/96/1010: Commission refocuses trade policy towards market opening for European companies.

- IP/96/1011: Statement by Padraig Flynn, European Commissioner with responsability for employment and social affairs on the European Court of Justice ruling on the UK challenge to the "working time directive".
- IP/96/1012: Commission clears the creation of a joint venture between ESPN and Star.
- IP/96/1013: Commission clears Allianz' acquisition of sole control of Vereinte.
- Speech/96/279: Statement by Commissioner Erkki Liikanen on Court of Auditors' annual report of 1995 and the statement of assurance (DAS).
- IP/96/283: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer to the conference on local development.
- Memo/96/107: Court of Auditors report 1995; sound and efficient management (SEM 2000) initiative.
- Memo/96/108: Background note on the market access strategy.
- Memo/96/109: Background: Facts about the working time directive./
- Judgment of the Court of Justice - 12 November 1996: Council directive 93/104/EC concerning certain aspects of the organization of working time - action for annulment.
- Court of Justice Press release No 53/96: Judgment of the Court of Justice in case C-84/94, United Kingdom v Council.
- Business and consumers surveys, first results: October 1996 - No 10.
- Main points of the Commission's weekly meeting agenda of 13 November 1996 in Strasbourg.
- Single market news - October 1996 - No 5.
- Eurostat, Statistics in focus, Economy and finance No 1996-10: The European Union and the APEC countries, evidence from national accounts figures.
- A market access strategy for the European Union.
- Eurostat news release No 74/96: EU unemployment: 10.8% in September.
- ME96/12.11: Midday express.
